safetyBehavior: Low-confidence fields are blanked independently while reliable partial fields survive.
Adjacent partial rows are never merged by guesswork.
A phone-only row is not treated as a person anchor.
Any uncertain non-empty required value must be explicitly edited before commit.
False rows remain removable in mandatory review and removed rows are not persisted.
Source images and adjusted blobs are transient and never enter persisted course state.
